FAQ

Common questions

Where is Al Nazha Tours located?

Our office is on Cinema Road, opposite Hassan Trading, in Khorfakkan, Sharjah, UAE.

How long does an Umrah visa take?

Processing times vary by season. Contact us with your travel dates and we will advise on the current timeline.

Can I book over WhatsApp?

Yes. Send us your requirements on WhatsApp at 050 367 4950 and we will reply with options and a quote.

Do you arrange visas for family members visiting the UAE?

Yes, we process UAE visit visas for family and friends. We will share the document checklist when you get in touch.
